title: Same Query, Different Answer: Run-to-Run Variance in Semantic Query Processing
abstract: arXiv:2610.13823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic query engines ask a large language model (LLM) to judge individual rows, and benchmarks compare these engines on the quality of a few executions at temperature 0. We measure how much another execution changes. We re-execute the text and tabular workloads of SemBench, LRO-Bench, and UDA-Bench through their own harnesses, log every one of 1.2 million model calls, and reanalyze SemBench's published executions. At temperature 0, between 0.07% and 10.2% of rows change their operator output over five executions, depending on the model, and up to 24.0% on one task. Plans amplify these changes exponentially in the number of rows an answer exposes, as a possible-worlds model predicts: on UDA-Bench, a few percent of extracted values change, but about two thirds of the answers do. translated_title: 相同的查询，不同的答案：语义查询处理中的运行间方差
translated_abstract: 语义查询引擎让大型语言模型（LLM）来判断单个数据行，而基准测试通常在温度为0的设置下通过少量执行的质量来比较这些引擎。我们测量了再次执行会带来多大的结果变化。我们通过各自的测试框架重新执行了SemBench、LRO-Bench和UDA-Bench的文本与表格工作负载，记录了全部120万次模型调用，并重新分析了SemBench已公布的执行结果。在温度为0时，五次执行之间有0.07%至10.2%的行的算子输出会发生变化（取决于具体模型），在某一任务上甚至高达24.0%。正如可能世界模型所预测的，查询计划会随答案所暴露的行数呈指数级放大这些变化：在UDA-Bench上，只有百分之几的提取值发生变化，但约三分之二的答案会发生改变。在SemBench已公布的结果中，21%的文本结果在不同执行之间质量发生变化，其中包括计划为确定性的引擎。
tldr: 该研究首次系统测量了语义查询引擎多次执行间的结果方差，发现即使在温度为0时也有最高超过10%的行输出会改变，且查询计划会指数级放大这种不确定性，导致约三分之二的最终答案发生变化，说明基于少量执行的基准测试评估并不可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically measures run-to-run variance in semantic query engines, finding that even at temperature 0 up to 10% of row outputs change across executions, and query plans amplify this uncertainty exponentially—altering about two-thirds of final answers—showing that benchmark evaluations based on few executions are unreliable.
